title: Customer prefix rejected — own AS appears in AS_PATH (eBGP loop guard)
symptom: R2 receives an UPDATE from R3 (192.0.2.2) advertising prefix 10.1.0.0/24, but the prefix does not appear in R2's BGP table. R3 is re-advertising a route that it originally learned from AS 65001 via another path.

inject.note: Simulates R3 re-advertising back to AS 65001 a route whose AS_PATH contains 65001. BGP loop prevention (RFC 4271 §9.1.2) causes R2 to discard the UPDATE silently.

ground_truth.root_cause: AS_PATH loop detected: own AS 65001 appears in AS_PATH of UPDATE from R3 (192.0.2.2) — prefix discarded by eBGP loop prevention
ground_truth.fix: Fix R3 route policy to avoid re-advertising routes learned from AS 65001 back to AS 65001
ground_truth.verify: show ip bgp 10.1.0.0/24 shows prefix accepted after R3 policy is corrected
